newsitem.title: UK: Berisford up, says received bid approach.
newsitem.headline: Berisford up, says received bid approach.

text.p: Shares in Berisford Plc rose in early trading on Friday after the company said in its full-year results statement it had received a possible takeover offer.
The stock was up 24p at 145 by 0812 GMT.

The company said "formal interest" had been expressed in an offer being made for the company. It said the approach had "only been of a preliminary nature such that it is unclear whether it may whether it may or may not lead to an offer being made."

Yet it said that because of the offer, it had been advised that it was impracticable to launch an earlier proposed buy-back of its convertible unsecured loan stock until the situation had been clarified.
It gave no further details of the bid approach.
